race.comment: GIAPPONESE (10) tough entire who gives every indication of running the 2000m. Started this campaign on June 3 and assess on the solid win over 1820m at Eagle Farm three starts back. Senior rider hops aboard and gets every chance from the rails draw. OCEAN TSUNAMI (12) progressive mare building a strong winning CV. Should have little trouble getting the 2000m after the dominant on speed win over 1700m at Scone. Can overcome the draw and go close. MICHELANGELO (14) Bathurst Cup winner three back and kept fresh for this. Since fitted with a 1000m trial placing at Orange and proven at the trip. Well weighted with the 3kg claim and has excellent each way prospects. VILLASAURUS (7) lacks early speed but has a powerful turn of foot on his day and looks suited by this rise in trip. Watch for him launching late.
